item: Sink sweep 10: record files that leave the install or join the live logs go through the passphrase scrub whole-line first
summary: The file-content reader audit found four raw paths: the single-file backup's logs/* members, the volume backup's staged copies, the restore merge of a backup's log lines into the live logs, and the quoted reason of a failed qualification bundle; plus the standalone session-forensics route had no net. New scrubbed_copy streams a log line by line through the scrub (overlong line = counted marker); each site has a test that fails when its scrub goes.
